option_relations.rationale: The option describes severe COVID-19 pneumonia with ARDS in pregnancy, which is equivalent to the leaf 'COVID-19 pneumonia with acute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS) in pregnancy'.
Community-acquired pneumonia is a broad category and does not specify COVID-19 or ARDS in pregnancy, making it distinct from the specific leaf.
Acute viral pneumonia (non-COVID) explicitly excludes COVID-19, which is the core of the leaf diagnosis.
COVID-19 pneumonia with respiratory failure is a broader category that encompasses COVID-19 pneumonia with ARDS in pregnancy, as ARDS is a severe form of respiratory failure.
